**Body:**

The New Orleans Pelicans in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #18 Zion Williamson 63.7
- #49 Trey Murphy III 57.7
- #110 Saddiq Bey 51.5
- #201 Derik Queen 44.1
- #205 Yves Missi 43.4
- #217 Karlo Matković 42.8
- #227 Bennedict Mathurin 42.2
- #243 Jordan Poole 41.4

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
